fulfillSettlement(uint256,uint64,bytes).notice: Step 3 of settlement. Submit the decrypted payout + Teecryptor signature (obtained         off-chain via `client.decryptForTx(handle).withoutACP()`); this verifies the signature         on-chain and pays the owner in USDG.

openHedge(bytes32,bytes32,bytes,bytes32,.notice: Open an encrypted hedge on `eventId`. `encSize` is the notional payout you receive if         you win; direction (`encIsYes`) and size stay encrypted. The premium is computed on-chain         from the public odds and your encrypted inputs, then locked from your confidential         collateral. (The frontend SDK batches both inputs under one signature; on-chain each is         verified with its own proof so the flow also works with per-input encryption.)

payoutHandle(uint256).notice: The encrypted payout handle for a settled position (for the off-chain decrypt step).

requestSettlement(uint256).notice: Step 1 of settlement (anyone / keeper). Requires the market resolved. Computes the         payout branchlessly (winner gets the full notional, loser gets 0) and marks it publicly         decryptable. Off-chain, decrypt the emitted handle and call `fulfillSettlement`.
